# SQLite amalgamation

This directory contains the SQLite 3.45.2 amalgamation (`sqlite3.c` and
`sqlite3.h`) downloaded from the official SQLite source distribution:

`https://www.sqlite.org/2024/sqlite-amalgamation-3450200.zip`

SQLite is in the public domain. The vendored source is compiled with extension
loading disabled for the native SIDECHANNEL reference build.
